title: RC-03 Revision Production Green Gate

requiredEvidence.requirement: Canonical OpenAPI exposes list, get and rollback revision operations with exact schemas and errors.
Private revisions are visible only to authorized owners/scoped editors.
Historical revisions cannot be modified or deleted through the revision API.
Rollback requires If-Match and rejects stale content versions fail-closed.
Retrying the same rollback request cannot create duplicate resulting revisions.
Integration tests prove rollback creates a new revision and preserves complete lineage/audit evidence.

greenRule: RC-03 is GREEN only when every requiredEvidence item is PASS and CI records immutable evidence references.
implementationBlocker: The current GitHub main branch still lacks the synchronized application implementation baseline required for executable domain tests.
